# v006 Native Test Inputs

`plan.json` and `design.json` are versionable copies of the main-authored v006
candidate, not production runtime files or approvals. Tests must run without
reading ignored `runtime/projects` drafts. Narration and actual measured phrase
and word estimates reuse `../derivative-intro-voiced/` fixtures, unchanged.

Native placeholders test clocks, geometry and lifecycle only. The real-Tex mode
uses actual native SemanticFormula/Tex geometry with a CPU animation adapter,
not GL pixels, listening, regression approval or publication permission. All
witnesses expire on source, plan, text, timing or native-runtime changes.
